title: Repayment Plan Down Payments by Practices — Network Participation Agreements
content:
Under the **Network Participation Agreements**, a practice may, at its own request, pay a down payment directly to Cascade to place the open overpayments of an agreement in a repayment plan. This rule covers only that plan down payment.

The down payment is recorded as a refund received against the agreement's overpayment with the most recent notice date.

## When the down payment is fixed

A plan down payment is not fixed until the latest claim payment run carries the post-decision withholding owed on the overpayment of the agreement's most recent dispute decision.

## Effect

When the practice pays, Cascade records the payment as a refund received on the practice's overpayment ledger, against the overpayment named. The open amount of that overpayment falls by the amount paid, and the practice receives a payment confirmation.

## Invocation: `pay_plan_down_payment_331c146f`

**Capability.** The practice pays Cascade part of its open overpayments on an agreement directly. It does so by authorising an electronic payment from its own account for the amount it has been told.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over. The customer themselves, the practice, then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `provider_agreement_id` | Reference number of the network participation agreement the payment is made on, as read out to the practice by the representative from the agreement lookup | Id |
| `original_payment_event_id` | Reference number of the overpayment notice entry the down payment is recorded against, as read out to the practice from the provider payment and overpayment lookup | Id |
| `down_payment_amount` | The amount the practice pays, as stated to the practice by the representative | USD, positive, 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary confirming the payment:

- `status`: the text "received" when the payment was recorded;
- `confirmation_id`: reference number of the refund-received entry;
- `provider_agreement_id`: echoed;
- `overpayment_case_number`: case number of the overpayment the payment was recorded against;
- `amount`: USD with 2 decimal places;
- `event_date`: date YYYY-MM-DD of receipt.
